verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and to Aaron, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.he: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂרֹ֔ו זֹובֹ֖ו טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُولَا لَهُمْ: كُلُّ رَجُلٍ يَكُونُ لَهُ سَيْلٌ مِنْ لَحْمِهِ، فَسَيْلُهُ نَجِسٌ.
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, his issue is unclean.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, [because of] his issue he [is] unclean.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

verses.he: וְזֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָתֹ֖ו בְּזֹובֹ֑ו רָ֣ר בְּשָׂרֹ֞ו אֶת־זֹובֹ֗ו אֹֽו־הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרֹו֙ מִזֹּובֹ֔ו טֻמְאָתֹ֖ו הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ تَكُونُ نَجَاسَتُهُ بِسَيْلِهِ: إِنْ كَانَ لَحْمُهُ يَبْصُقُ سَيْلَهُ، أَوْ يَحْتَبِسُ لَحْمُهُ عَنْ سَيْلِهِ، فَذَلِكَ نَجَاسَتُهُ.
verses.en: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
verses.kjv: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it [is] his uncleanness.
verses.web: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

verses.he: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכָֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ فِرَاشٍ يَضْطَجِعُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ ٱلسَّيْلُ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا، وَكُلُّ مَتَاعٍ يَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا.
verses.en: Every bed whereon he that hath the issue lieth shall be unclean; and every thing whereon he sitteth shall be unclean.
verses.kjv: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.web: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּבֹ֑ו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَمَنْ مَسَّ فِرَاشَهُ يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَمَنْ جَلَسَ عَلَى ٱلْمَتَاعِ ٱلَّذِي يَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ ذُو ٱلسَّيْلِ، يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And he that sitteth on [any] thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَمَنْ مَسَّ لَحْمَ ذِي ٱلسَّيْلِ يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יָרֹ֛ק הַזָּ֖ב בַּטָּהֹ֑ור וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ بَصَقَ ذُو ٱلسَّيْلِ عَلَى طَاهِرٍ، يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְכָל־הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَا يَرْكَبُ عَلَيْهِ ذُو ٱلسَّيْلِ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا.
verses.en: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.
verses.kjv: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.web: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

verses.he: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנֹּושֵׂ֣א אֹותָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّ كُلَّ مَا كَانَ تَحْتَهُ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ، وَمَنْ حَمَلَهُنَّ يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even; and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth [any of] those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע־בֹּו֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא־שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّهُ ذُو ٱلسَّيْلِ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْ يَدَيْهِ بِمَاءٍ، يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And whomsoever he that hath the issue toucheth, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע־בֹּ֥ו הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל־כְּלִי־עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.ar: وَإِنَاءُ ٱلْخَزَفِ ٱلَّذِي يَمَسُّهُ ذُو ٱلسَّيْلِ يُكْسَرُ. وَكُلُّ إِنَاءِ خَشَبٍ يُغْسَلُ بِمَاءٍ.
verses.en: And the earthen vessel, which he that hath the issue toucheth, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.kjv: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.web: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזֹּובֹ֔ו וְסָ֨פַר לֹ֜ו שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָתֹ֖ו וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂרֹ֛ו בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.ar: وَإِذَا طَهُرَ ذُو ٱلسَّيْلِ مِنْ سَيْلِهِ، يُحْسَبُ لَهُ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ لِطُهْرِهِ، وَيَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَرْحَضُ جَسَدَهُ بِمَاءٍ حَيٍّ فَيَطْهُرُ.
verses.en: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue, then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.kjv: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.web: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

verses.he: וּבַיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח־לֹו֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים אֹ֥ו שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יֹונָ֑ה וּבָ֣א ׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّامِنِ يَأْخُذُ لِنَفْسِهِ يَمَامَتَيْنِ أَوْ فَرْخَيْ حَمَامٍ، وَيَأْتِي إِلَى أَمَامِ ٱلرَّبِّ، إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَيُعْطِيهِمَا لِلْكَاهِنِ،
verses.en: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest.
verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.web: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

verses.he: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזֹּובֹֽו׃ ס
verses.ar: فَيَعْمَلُهُمَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ: ٱلْوَاحِدَ ذَبِيحَةَ خَطِيَّةٍ، وَٱلْآخَرَ مُحْرَقَةً. وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنْ سَيْلِهِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer them, the one [for] a sin offering, and the other [for] a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.web: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־כָּל־בְּשָׂרֹ֖ו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا حَدَثَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ ٱضْطِجَاعُ زَرْعٍ، يَرْحَضُ كُلَّ جَسَدِهِ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And if the flow of seed go out from a man, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְכָל־בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל־עֹ֔ור אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃ פ
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ ثَوْبٍ وَكُلُّ جِلْدٍ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ ٱضْطِجَاعُ زَرْعٍ يُغْسَلُ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the flow of seed, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلَّتِي يَضْطَجِعُ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ ٱضْطِجَاعَ زَرْعٍ، يَسْتَحِمَّانِ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونَانِ نَجِسَيْنِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: The woman also with whom a man shall lie carnally, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: The woman also with whom man shall lie [with] seed of copulation, they shall [both] bathe [themselves] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי־תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا كَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ لَهَا سَيْلٌ، وَكَانَ سَيْلُهَا دَمًا فِي لَحْمِهَا، فَسَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ تَكُونُ فِي طَمْثِهَا. وَكُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّهَا يَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days; and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if a woman have an issue, [and] her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.web: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَا تَضْطَجِعُ عَلَيْهِ فِي طَمْثِهَا يَكُونُ نَجِسًا، وَكُلُّ مَا تَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا.
verses.en: And every thing that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean; every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.kjv: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.web: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

verses.he: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّ فِرَاشَهَا يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל־כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّ مَتَاعًا تَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ، يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא אֹ֧ו עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעֹו־בֹ֑ו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْفِرَاشِ أَوْ عَلَى ٱلْمَتَاعِ ٱلَّذِي هِيَ جَالِسَةٌ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَمَا يَمَسُّهُ، يَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And if he be on the bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And if it [be] on [her] bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.web: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃ פ
verses.ar: وَإِنِ ٱضْطَجَعَ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ فَكَانَ طَمْثُهَا عَلَيْهِ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ. وَكُلُّ فِرَاشٍ يَضْطَجِعُ عَلَيْهِ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا.
verses.en: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.kjv: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.web: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

verses.he: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־יָזוּב֩ זֹ֨וב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־נִדָּתָ֔הּ אֹ֥ו כִֽי־תָז֖וּב עַל־נִדָּתָ֑הּ כָּל־יְמֵ֞י זֹ֣וב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا كَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ يَسِيلُ سَيْلُ دَمِهَا أَيَّامًا كَثِيرَةً فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ طَمْثِهَا، أَوْ إِذَا سَالَ بَعْدَ طَمْثِهَا، فَتَكُونُ كُلَّ أَيَّامِ سَيَلَانِ نَجَاسَتِهَا كَمَا فِي أَيَّامِ طَمْثِهَا. إِنَّهَا نَجِسَةٌ.
verses.en: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.
verses.kjv: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she [shall be] unclean.
verses.web: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

verses.he: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י זֹובָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל־הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ فِرَاشٍ تَضْطَجِعُ عَلَيْهِ كُلَّ أَيَّامِ سَيْلِهَا يَكُونُ لَهَا كَفِرَاشِ طَمْثِهَا. وَكُلُّ ٱلْأَمْتِعَةِ ٱلَّتِي تَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهَا تَكُونُ نَجِسَةً كَنَجَاسَةِ طَمْثِهَا.
verses.en: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity; and every thing whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
verses.kjv: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.web: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

verses.he: וְכָל־הַנֹּוגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّهُنَّ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا، فَيَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَسْتَحِمُّ بِمَاءٍ، وَيَكُونُ نَجِسًا إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ.
verses.en: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.web: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.he: וְאִֽם־טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזֹּובָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ مِنْ سَيْلِهَا تَحْسُبُ، لِنَفْسِهَا سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ تَطْهُرُ.
verses.en: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.kjv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.web: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.he: וּבַיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח־לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים אֹ֥ו שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יֹונָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אֹותָם֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّامِنِ تَأْخُذُ لِنَفْسِهَا يَمَامَتَيْنِ أَوْ فَرْخَيْ حَمَامٍ، وَتَأْتِي بِهِمَا إِلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִזֹּ֖וב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: فَيَعْمَلُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ: ٱلْوَاحِدَ ذَبِيحَةَ خَطِيَّةٍ، وَٱلْآخَرَ مُحْرَقَةً. وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنْ سَيْلِ نَجَاسَتِهَا.
verses.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one [for] a sin offering, and the other [for] a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.web: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.

verses.he: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֙תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתֹוכָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَتَعْزِلَانِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ نَجَاسَتِهِمْ لِئَلَّا يَمُوتُوا فِي نَجَاسَتِهِمْ بِتَنْجِيسِهِمْ مَسْكَنِيَ ٱلَّذِي فِي وَسَطِهِمْ.
verses.en: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile My tabernacle that is in the midst of them.
verses.kjv: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that [is] among them.
verses.web: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

verses.he: זֹ֥את תֹּורַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֖רַע לְטָמְאָה־בָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: «هَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ذِي ٱلسَّيْلِ، وَٱلَّذِي يَحْدُثُ مِنْهُ ٱضْطِجَاعُ زَرْعٍ فَيَتَنَجَّسُ بِهَا،
verses.en: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him from whom the flow of seed goeth out, so that he is unclean thereby;
verses.kjv: This [is] the law of him that hath an issue, and [of him] whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.web: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

verses.he: וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת־זֹובֹ֔ו לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם־טְמֵאָֽה׃ פ
verses.ar: وَٱلْعَلِيلَةِ فِي طَمْثِهَا، وَٱلسَّائِلِ سَيْلُهُ: ٱلذَّكَرِ وَٱلْأُنْثَى، وَٱلرَّجُلِ ٱلَّذِي يَضْطَجِعُ مَعَ نَجِسَةٍ».
verses.en: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of them that have an issue, whether it be a man, or a woman; and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.kjv: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.web: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
